title: 666 – il marchio della Spiaggia Lucciola Elettrica con un ricarico del 13 percento
summary: The numbers 666 and 13 don’t have the best of reputations in certain circles, but Chinese car brand Nio hopes its latest Firefly hatchback will have better luck with them – offering a limited run of 666 special edition EVs at a price that’s 13% higher than usual.

title: MacGregor says demand for its electric cranes is BOOMING in 2026
summary: Demand for MacGregor’s maritime cranes has been strong in the first half of 2026, and Swedish heavy lift experts say their electric offerings are now making up more than 80% of the company’s new crane orders.

title: Robot delivery dog dumps hot steaming packages on your doorstep [video]
summary:
The new R-dog delivery robot hopes to replace your local gig-workers with a friendly face, red cap, approachable design, and even furry tail – all cute and adorable, until it poops your package onto your porch.

Oh, and it runs ads the entire time.

title: Illinois just made 40 mph e-bikes street legal – but there’s a huge catch
summary: Illinois just signed a sweeping new electric bicycle law that, among many other changes, finally answers a question that has been hanging over the rapidly growing market for high-powered electric bikes: What exactly are we supposed to do with all of these 35 and 40 mph “e-bikes” that don’t fit into the normal three-class electric bicycle system?

title: Kia is recalling over 21,000 EV9 SUVs over a faulty airbag issue
summary: Kia issued a recall affecting more than 21,000 EV9 SUVs because the airbag system may fail to detect a child in the front seat.

title: 1 in 7 US students now goes to a solar-powered school
summary: Solar power now powers more than 10,800 US K-12 schools – that means 1 in 7 students goes to a school powered by the sun – but battery storage hasn’t quite caught on yet.

title: Podcast: Tesla Cybercab launch, Cybertruck prices rise, VW launch electric camper, and more
summary:
In the Electrek Podcast, we discuss the most popular news in the world of sustainable transport and energy. In this week’s episode, we discuss Tesla announcing the Cybercab launch, Cybertruck prices rising, VW launching an electric camper, and more.

Today’s episode is sponsored by GM. GM EV charging made easy, with Energy Pass and Plug and Charge. Learn more at https://gmenergy.gm.com/energypass

title: Porsche Cayenne Turbo EV first drive: Most Powerful Porsche ever … is an SUV
summary: After chomping on the bit for literally years, we finally got to drive – and I mean really drive – the Porsche Cayenne Electric, and it was everything we’d hoped for, and more. Porsche flew us out to Aspen, Colorado, and gave us a 250-ish-mile mountain road (and off-road) course to devour with their flagship SUV. The $163K monster did not disappoint in acceleration, air-supported suspension comfort, and even fast charging. But, there, as always, are some caveats beyond the huge price tag…

title: Hyundai is launching a new electric SUV that will sit above the IONIQ 5
summary: Hyundai has several new electric SUVs coming, including a new global D-segment SUV positioned slightly above the IONIQ 5.

title: VW Turned The ID. Buzz Into An Electric Camper Van. The U.S. Is Next.
summary: The Volkswagen ID. California Cruise is a simple camper van based on the retro-styled ID. Buzz. A U.S. version is coming too.

title: BYD Is Building Its Ultra-Fast Flash Charging Network At A Ferocious Pace
summary: Its Flash Charging network just hit 10,000 stations and a third of the people using them don't even drive a BYD.

title: Lucid Recalls 27,185 Air Sedans Over Fire Risk, Tells Owners To Park Outside
summary: More than 27,000 Lucid Air sedans are being recalled over a fire risk. The good news? Lucid says the fix is just an OTA update.

title: Rivian's CFO Is Leaving The Company
summary: Claire McDonough spent six years with the EV startup and leaves as it races to ramp up R2 sales.

title: BMW Just Hit 2 Million EVs Sold, And The iX3 Is Carrying The Team
summary: If you include plug-in hybrids, BMW is up to 3.5 million EVs sold.

title: Aptera's Solar-Powered EV Can Go 47 Miles On Sun Power Alone—In Theory
summary: Don't just take Aptera's word for it. The results are from independent testing by TÜV Rheinland.

title: Here Are Some Of The Biggest Changes On The New Chevy Bolt
summary: The new Bolt won't be made for long, but it's a big improvement over the old car.

title: Voltpost Is Making A Charger For People Without A Driveway
summary: Voltpost's new chargers cut install costs by sticking to ceilings and walls—meaning apartment dwellers could be the real winners.

title: How The Volvo EX60 EV Can 'See' Deer Around Corners Through A New Update
summary: It's not just deer, either. The Volvo can even detect people and other hazards before you do.

title: Hyundai’s New Santa Fe Will Go Electric And Keep The Gas Tank
summary: The extended-range electric vehicle will be made in the U.S. at Hyundai’s Alabama plant.
